messages.say: Pročitaj Instructions ovog, novog Projekta
Pročitao sam i razumeo Instructions ovog novog projekta.

Poštovani članovi tima, pred vama je sažeti rezime dobijen ukrštanjem 5 eksternih konfiguracionih fajlova različitih autora. Cilj nam je da ovim presecima precizno usmerimo fokus za naš novi projekat.

Napominjem ključnu stvar: Ovu listu koristimo isključivo kao polaznu smernicu. To ne znači da ćemo sve sa spiska bezuslovno primeniti, niti da ćemo se ograničiti samo na ove stavke – prostor za prilagođavanje je širom otvoren. Sve informacije unutar ovog fajla dolaze iz proverenih, stabilnih i funkcionalnih build-ova.

Modelima koji u svom interfejsu podržavaju unos tekstualnih fajlova proslediću ovaj dokument i kroz chat i kroz fajl sekciju, dok ostalima ide direktno u chat.

Za sada nemojte praviti nikakve strategije niti pisati korake unapred. Jedini zadatak u ovom trenutku jeste da potvrdite da ste razumeli koncept, smernice našeg cilja i da li ste tehnički spremni za njegovo dostizanje.

Ništa ovde nije 'zacementirano'. Negujemo pravu demokratiju – nas petoro je u timu i svaka odluka se donosi glasom proste većine. Unapred hvala na kratkom i preciznom odgovoru.

Razumeo sam koncept, smernice i cilj projekta.

Tehnički sam spreman da učestvujem u dostizanju postavljenog cilja. Spisak prihvatam kao polaznu bazu za kasniju tehničku evaluaciju, a ne kao unapred obavezujuću specifikaciju.

Za sada neću iznositi strategije, procene pojedinačnih stavki niti predlagati korake.

Dobro jutro, kolega. Krećemo sa razradom strukture. Na osnovu našeg master fajla, tvoj prvi zadatak je da napraviš preglednu tabelu zavisnosti za komponente koje planiramo da gasimo (posebno se osvrni na servise vezane za Windows Update, Indexing i Windows Defender). Prikupi i organizuj te podatke u čistu listu da imamo jasan uvid šta vuče šta.

Dobro jutro, kolega. Krećemo od dependency mape, ne od same liste za uklanjanje. Bitno je da razlikujemo direktnu SCM zavisnost od funkcionalne zavisnosti - gašenje neke usluge može proći bez greške pri bootu, ali prekinuti funkciju drugog sistema.

5. Najvažniji nalaz za BlueLite

Tri grupe ne treba tretirati istim metodom:

🔴 A - Windows Update

Sistemski dependency cluster.

wuauserv → BITS / CryptSvc / RPC / Firewall / UsoSvc / WaaSMedic / DoSvc

Ovde prvo moramo odlučiti da li cilj znači:

samo disable,

servicing-time removal, ili

potpuno offline uklanjanje komponenata iz install.wim-a.

To nisu ekvivalentne operacije.

🟡 B - Windows Search

Relativno izolovan feature cluster.

WSearch → index/catalog → search clients

Ovde je prostor za agresivno uklanjanje znatno čistiji. Microsoft čak dokumentuje da se Search komponente mogu ponovo registrovati zasebno, što potvrđuje da UI i indexing nisu jedna nerazdvojna komponenta. (Microsoft Learn)

🔴 C - Defender

Security + update cross-dependency cluster.

WinDefend / WdNisSvc / drivers ←→ WU/BITS + security infrastructure

Ovo je posebno važno jer uklanjanje Windows Update-a automatski menja i Defender update path. Microsoft potvrđuje da Defender security-intelligence i engine updates koriste Windows Update/BITS infrastrukturu. (Microsoft Learn)

Ovo je, po meni, dobra prva dependency mapa, ali još nije lista „šta brišemo“. Sledeći tehnički korak treba da bude mnogo precizniji: za svaki kandidat razdvojiti Remove from WIM / Disable service / Disable scheduled task / Remove package / Registry policy / Feature disable, jer tek tada možemo videti šta je stvarna ušteda footprinta, a šta je samo konfiguraciona optimizacija.

Sources:

Troubleshoot Windows Update Error 0x800706D9 - Windows Client | Microsoft Learn

Radimo samo ti i ja. Svi ostali su otpušteni iz tima. Ako si spreman da zajedno, samo ti i ja, ostvarimo zadati cilj, od početka do kraja, apsolutno svaki korak, komandu, tweak i kasnije u NTLite, onda nastavljamo. Imaš u sekciji Library dva txt fajla: CustomAppsList.txt je file koji UUP skripta isporuči u download folder NAKON downloada, a drugi je UUP_Timeline_CMD.txt - PowerShell kopija svih koraka koje skripta radi u toku downloada. Pokazalo se da su oba txt fajla veoma korisni zbog tačnih imena paketa i apps, kao i preciznog redosleda i spiska svega što je ušlo u konačnu verziju originalnog UUP ISO fajla.
Radi preciznih skripti koje isporučuješ, sledi moja lokalno postavljena folder struktura:
Osnovni > "C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work"
Original UUP install.wim > "C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\extracted\install.wim"
Mount folder > "C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount"
Prethodnu tvoju poruku i strukturu sam pažljivo sagledao i sada, ako si spreman, nastavljamo dalje, ali imaj u vidu sve što sam izneo u ovoj poruci. Kada isporučuješ skripte, uputstva, objašnjenja i planove, to radi isključivo korak po korak, nikako više koraka ili objašnjenja unapred. Može?

Može.

Prihvatam da od ovog trenutka radimo samo ti i ja, od početne analize do finalnog ISO-a, uključujući DISM/PowerShell, Registry, dependency proveru, tweakove i završnu obradu u NTLite-u.

Takođe prihvatam striktno pravilo rada:

jedan korak → izvršavanje/provera → tek onda sledeći korak.

Neću unapred izbacivati višekoračne planove, komande ili buduće izmene. Kada dođemo do određene faze, dobićeš samo ono što je potrebno za taj konkretan korak.

Za CustomAppsList.txt i UUP_Timeline_CMD.txt koristićemo ih kao referentni izvor za tačna imena paketa, aplikacija, komponenti i redosled UUP obrade, umesto da nagađamo nazive.

Folder strukturu koju si naveo uzimam kao našu radnu putanju:

C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work
├── extracted\
│   └── install.wim
└── mount\

Spreman sam. Krećemo od prvog koraka.

Install.wim je montiran. Dodajem ti i informaciju o još dve putanje, mada ti one ne znače mnogo za rad, ali ipak da ih imaš u memoriji, a to su:
"C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\scripts" (u tom folderu čuvam sve što pošalješ, pod svojim rednim brojevima;
"C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\backup" (ako zatreba u toku rada, trenutno je prazan).
Ponavljam da radimo maksimalni debloat, da čak maximalno smanjujemo i WinSxS, pauziramo update do 31. Decembra 2100. god. sa mogućnošću da ih korisnik Resume, ali i ponovo pauzira do željenog perioda, ostavljamo neke od osnovnih app, kao što su Notepad, Calculator, Win Photo Viewer, satićemo se kasnije u toku rada još nekih. Radimo dve verzije pri prvom boot: Defender OFF / Defender ON. To su neke od stvari koje već znaš, ali ću ih nekoliko puta ponavljati i, dodavati čega se setim, ali ti je suština i cilj poznat. Ne radi se ovde u našem radu "da li ćemo", nego "kojim redom" ćemo doći do cilja. Dakle, krećemo, wim je u mount folderu...

Razumem. Putanje i pravila rada su zabeleženi:

C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\scripts — naše numerisane skripte.

C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\backup — trenutno prazan, koristićemo ga samo kada bude potrebno.

install.wim je već montiran u mount.

Cilj ostaje maksimalni debloat, uključujući agresivno smanjenje WinSxS.

Windows Update će biti podešen na pauzu do 31.12.2100, uz korisničku mogućnost Resume i ponovne pauze.

Zadržavamo osnovne aplikacije; početni minimum uključuje Notepad, Calculator i Windows Photo Viewer.

Prvi boot treba da podrži Defender OFF / Defender ON varijante.

Sve ostalo ćemo precizno definisati tokom rada.

Jedan korak u jednom trenutku.

KORAK 1 — potvrda stvarnog Mount stanja

Pošto je WIM već montiran, još ništa ne menjamo. Prvo proveravamo da li DISM zaista vidi odgovarajući mounted image i koji mu je status.

Otvori PowerShell kao Administrator i izvrši samo ovu komandu:

DISM /Get-MountedWimInfo

Pošalji mi ceo izlaz komande.

Ne izvršavaj još ništa drugo.

KORAK 2 — evidentiranje početnog stanja

Sada pravimo prvi naš numerisani script, koji samo prikuplja stanje montiranog WIM-a. Ne uklanja, ne disable-uje i ne menja ništa.

Sačuvaj ga kao:

C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\scripts\01_Initial_WIM_State.ps1

Sadržaj:

# ============================================================
# BlueLite 25H2 26200.9278
# 01 - Initial WIM State
#
# PURPOSE:
#   Collect baseline information from the mounted WIM.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   This script is READ-ONLY.
#   It does not remove, disable, modify or install anything.
# ============================================================

$MountDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount'
$OutputDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\backup'
$TimeStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'

if (-not (Test-Path $MountDir)) {
    throw "Mount folder not found: $MountDir"
}

$OutputFile = Join-Path $OutputDir "01_Initial_WIM_State_$TimeStamp.txt"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDir -Force | Out-Null

"============================================================" | Out-File $OutputFile
"BlueLite 25H2 26200.9278 - Initial WIM State"              | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
"Date: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')"           | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
"Mount: $MountDir"                                          | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
"============================================================" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append

"`n[DISM MOUNTED IMAGE INFO]" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
DISM /Get-MountedWimInfo | Out-File $OutputFile -Append

"`n[WINDOWS VERSION]" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion' |
    Select-Object ProductName, DisplayVersion, CurrentBuild, UBR |
    Format-List |
    Out-File $OutputFile -Append

"`n[WIM PACKAGES]" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
DISM /Image:$MountDir /Get-Packages |
    Out-File $OutputFile -Append

"`n[WIM FEATURES]" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append
DISM /Image:$MountDir /Get-Features |
    Out-File $OutputFile -Append

"`n[WIM DRIVERS]" | Out-File $OutputFile -Append

    Out-File $OutputFile -Append

I dalje važi najvažnije: nismo ništa promenili u WIM-u.

Nećemo više pokušavati /Get-Packages dok ne utvrdimo uzrok 0xd0000043.

01 - OFFLINE REGISTRY + SERVICES

Prvo unload prethodnog privremenog hive-a, zatim izmene isključivo nad mountom.

# ============================================================
# 01 - BLUELITE OFFLINE BASE OPTIMIZATION
# Windows 11 25H2 / 26200.9278
#
# ISKLJUČIVO OFFLINE IMAGE:
# C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount
# ============================================================

$MountDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Ensure previous diagnostic COMPONENTS hive is unloaded
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteCOMPONENTS 2>$null

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load offline SOFTWARE hive
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe load HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE `
    "$MountDir\Windows\System32\Config\SOFTWARE"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to load offline SOFTWARE hive."
}

try {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SmartScreen OFF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System `
        /v EnableSmartScreen /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System `
        /v ShellSmartScreenLevel /t REG_SZ /d "Off" /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Copilot OFF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot `
        /v TurnOffWindowsCopilot /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Widgets OFF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Windows\Widgets `
        /v AllowWidgets /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # WER policy
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting `
        /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Windows Search indexing
    #
    # Service is handled below in SYSTEM hive.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

}
finally {
    reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load offline SYSTEM hive
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe load HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM `
    "$MountDir\Windows\System32\Config\SYSTEM"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to load offline SYSTEM hive."
}

try {

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable telemetry
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\DiagTrack `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\dmwappushservice `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Windows Error Reporting service
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WerSvc `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Windows Search indexing service
    #
    # We DISABLE it; we do not delete its package here.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WSearch `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Remote Registry
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\RemoteRegistry `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Remote Assistance helper service
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\RemoteAccess `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
    # Disable Windows Media Player Network Sharing
    # if present.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    reg.exe add `
        HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WMPNetworkSvc `
        /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

}
finally {
    reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM
}

# ============================================================
# 02 - BLUELITE PROVISIONED APPX DEBLOAT
# ============================================================

$MountDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KEEP - korisničke osnovne aplikacije
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Keep = @(
    'Microsoft.WindowsCalculator',
    'Microsoft.WindowsNotepad',
    'Microsoft.Windows.Photos'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KEEP - framework/dependency packages
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$KeepFramework = @(
    'Microsoft.UI.Xaml',
    'Microsoft.VCLibs',
    'Microsoft.NET.Native.Framework',
    'Microsoft.NET.Native.Runtime',
    'Microsoft.WindowsAppRuntime'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# REMOVE - poznati optional/bloat Appx
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Remove = @(
    'Microsoft.WindowsStore',
    'Microsoft.StorePurchaseApp',
    'Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller',

    'Microsoft.BingNews',
    'Microsoft.BingSearch',
    'Microsoft.BingWeather',

    'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection',
    'Microsoft.ZuneMusic',
    'Microsoft.ZuneVideo',

    'Microsoft.WindowsAlarms',
    'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub',
    'Microsoft.GetHelp',
    'Microsoft.Getstarted',

    'Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder',
    'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub',
    'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes',
    'Microsoft.Todos',

    'Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay',
    'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay',
    'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay',
    'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider',
    'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI',
    'Microsoft.GamingApp',

    'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop',

    'Microsoft.WindowsCamera',

    'MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience',
    'MicrosoftWindows.CrossDevice',

    'Clipchamp.Clipchamp',

    'MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist',
    'Microsoft.OutlookForWindows',
    'MicrosoftTeams',
    'MSTeams',

    'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome',
    'Microsoft.YourPhone',

    'MicrosoftCorporationII.MicrosoftFamily',

    'Microsoft.MicrosoftPCManager',

    'Microsoft.StartExperiencesApp',
    'Microsoft.WidgetsPlatformRuntime',

    'Microsoft.ScreenSketch',
    'Microsoft.Paint',

    'Microsoft.WindowsTerminal'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Get actual packages from OFFLINE image
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Packages = Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Path $MountDir

foreach ($Pkg in $Packages) {

    $Name = $Pkg.DisplayName

    # Explicit KEEP
    if (
        ($Keep | Where-Object { $Name -like "*$_*" }) -or
        ($KeepFramework | Where-Object { $Name -like "*$_*" })
    ) {
        Write-Host "KEEP   $($Pkg.PackageName)" -ForegroundColor Green
        continue
    }

    # Explicit REMOVE
    $Match = $Remove | Where-Object {
        $Name -like "*$_*" -or
        $Pkg.PackageName -like "*$_*"
    }

    if ($Match) {

        Write-Host "REMOVE $($Pkg.PackageName)" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage `
            -Path $MountDir `
            -PackageName $Pkg.PackageName `
            -ErrorAction Stop
    }
}

03 - FOD / OPTIONAL FEATURES

Ovde je najvažnija promena.

Nećemo hardkodovati .1742 package identity-je.

UUP timeline potvrđuje da su među FOD-ovima, između ostalog, IE, MediaPlayer, PowerShell ISE, Steps Recorder, TabletPCMath, VBSCRIPT, WMIC, Telnet, TFTP, OpenSSH, WinOCR, kao i brojni hardverski driver FOD-ovi. UUP_Timeline_CMD.txt UUP_Timeline_CMD.txt

Hardverske Ethernet/Wi-Fi FOD-ove ne diramo. Uklanjanje driver paketa koji su potrebni sistemu može napraviti boot/hardware problem; Microsoft izričito upozorava na to kod offline driver servicing-a. (Microsoft Learn)

# ============================================================
# 03 - BLUELITE FOD / OPTIONAL FEATURE DEBLOAT
# ============================================================

$MountDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Packages safe to TARGET for removal
#
# We discover the exact installed identity first.
# No hard-coded .1742 assumption.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$PackagePatterns = @(
    'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell-ISE-FOD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-StepsRecorder-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-InternetExplorer-Optional-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-MediaPlayer-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-VBSCRIPT-FoD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-WMIC-FoD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-Telnet-Client-FOD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-TFTP-Client-FOD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-AppServer-Client-FOD-Package',
    'OpenSSH-Client-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-Wallpaper-Content-Extended-FoD-Package'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# Hello Face is removable only if Face Recognition is not wanted.
# TabletPCMath is removable only if handwriting/math recognition
# is not wanted.
#
# We therefore keep them OUT of the first automatic pass.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Query actual offline package list.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$RawPackages = & DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Get-Packages

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "DISM /Get-Packages failed. STOP. Do not remove packages."
}

$PackageIdentities = foreach ($Line in $RawPackages) {
    if ($Line -match '^Package Identity\s*:\s*(.+)$') {
        $Matches[1].Trim()
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove only exact package families from the approved list.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

foreach ($Identity in $PackageIdentities) {

    $Target = $false

    foreach ($Pattern in $PackagePatterns) {

        if ($Identity -like "$Pattern*") {
            $Target = $true
            break
        }
    }

    if ($Target) {

        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "REMOVE FOD:" $Identity -ForegroundColor Yellow

        & DISM.exe `
            /Image:$MountDir `
            /Remove-Package `
            /PackageName:$Identity

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Failed removing package: $Identity"
        }
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional features that are explicitly non-essential.
# /Remove removes payload while retaining servicing metadata.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$OptionalFeatures = @(
    'Internet-Explorer-Optional-amd64',
    'PowerShell-ISE',
    'WorkFolders-Client',
    'Printing-XPSServices-Features',
    'TFTP'
)

foreach ($Feature in $OptionalFeatures) {

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Checking feature: $Feature" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $Info = & DISM.exe `
        /Image:$MountDir `
        /Get-FeatureInfo `
        /FeatureName:$Feature 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and
        ($Info -match 'State\s*:\s*Enabled')) {

        Write-Host "Removing feature payload: $Feature" -ForegroundColor Yellow

        & DISM.exe `
            /Image:$MountDir `
            /Disable-Feature `
            /FeatureName:$Feature `
            /Remove

        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Failed removing feature: $Feature"
        }
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "03 completed." -ForegroundColor Green

Microsoft dokumentuje /Remove-Package za offline package servicing i /Disable-Feature /Remove za uklanjanje optional-feature payload-a. (Microsoft Learn)

Napomena: Printing-XPSServices-Features sam namerno ostavio kao kandidat, neću ga automatski skidati bez prethodnog pregleda feature dependency-ja. U gornjoj skripti zato ga možemo izbaciti iz $OptionalFeatures za prvi prolaz ako želimo konzervativniji print stack. Moj izbor za BlueLite je da ga izbacimo iz automatskog prolaza.

Ovo je poslednji korak offline debloat faze.

I tek ovde radimo ResetBase.

Microsoft navodi upravo ovaj redosled za smanjivanje Component Store-a: StartComponentCleanup /ResetBase, zatim commit/unmount i export u novi WIM. (Microsoft Learn)

# ============================================================
# 04 - BLUELITE FINAL COMPONENT CLEANUP
# ============================================================

$MountDir   = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\mount'
$SourceWim  = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\extracted\install.wim'
$OutputWim  = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work\BlueLite-26200.9278-clean.wim'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure no diagnostic COMPONENTS hive remains loaded
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteCOMPONENTS 2>$null

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Verify mount
# ------------------------------------------------------------

DISM.exe /Get-MountedWimInfo

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to query mounted WIM."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Component Store analysis BEFORE cleanup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMPONENT STORE BEFORE CLEANUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Cleanup-Image `
    /AnalyzeComponentStore

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "AnalyzeComponentStore failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. StartComponentCleanup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== START COMPONENT CLEANUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Cleanup-Image `
    /StartComponentCleanup

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "StartComponentCleanup failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. ResetBase
#
# This permanently removes superseded component versions.
# Therefore this is deliberately LAST.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== RESET BASE ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Cleanup-Image `
    /StartComponentCleanup `
    /ResetBase

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "ResetBase failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Component Store analysis AFTER cleanup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMPONENT STORE AFTER CLEANUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Cleanup-Image `
    /AnalyzeComponentStore

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Post-cleanup analysis failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Verify WIM health
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== WIM HEALTH CHECK ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Image:$MountDir `
    /Cleanup-Image `
    /CheckHealth

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Offline WIM CheckHealth failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Commit and unmount
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== COMMIT + UNMOUNT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Unmount-Image `
    /MountDir:$MountDir `
    /Commit

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "WIM commit/unmount failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Export to a NEW WIM
#
# Maximum compression.
# Original install.wim remains untouched.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== EXPORTING CLEAN WIM ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Export-Image `
    /SourceImageFile:$SourceWim `
    /SourceIndex:1 `
    /DestinationImageFile:$OutputWim `
    /Compress:recovery `
    /CheckIntegrity

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "WIM export failed."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Final image information
# ------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== FINAL IMAGE INFO ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

DISM.exe `
    /Get-ImageInfo `
    /ImageFile:$OutputWim

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "============================================="
Write-Host " BLUELITE OFFLINE DEBLOAT PHASE COMPLETE"
Write-Host " Output: $OutputWim"
Write-Host "=============================================" -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================================
# 25H2 26200.9278 — FINAL SERVICING / PACKAGE STATE CHECK
# PowerShell 7
# ============================================================

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$WorkDir = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work'
$MountDir = Join-Path $WorkDir 'mount'
$LogDir = Join-Path $WorkDir 'logs'

$Servicing = Join-Path $MountDir 'Windows\Servicing'
$WinSxS    = Join-Path $MountDir 'Windows\WinSxS'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $LogDir -Force | Out-Null

$ServicingLog = Join-Path $LogDir '09-servicing-path-check.txt'
$StateLog     = Join-Path $LogDir '08-package-state-count.txt'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Verify servicing path
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Servicing -PathType Container) {

    $ServicingInfo = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Servicing

    @(
        'Servicing path exists.'
        "Path : $($ServicingInfo.FullName)"
        "Size : $([math]::Round(
            ((Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Servicing -Recurse -Force -File |
                Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB), 3
        )) GB"
    ) | Tee-Object -FilePath $ServicingLog

}
else {

    "Servicing path NOT FOUND: $Servicing" |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $ServicingLog

}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Verify WinSxS path and size
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $WinSxS -PathType Container) {

    $WinSxSBytes = (
        Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $WinSxS -Recurse -Force -File |
        Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum
    ).Sum

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Path   = $WinSxS
        SizeGB = [math]::Round($WinSxSBytes / 1GB, 2)
        SizeMB = [math]::Round($WinSxSBytes / 1MB, 0)
    } |
        Format-List |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '06-winsxs-size-check.txt')

}
else {

    "WinSxS path NOT FOUND: $WinSxS" |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '06-winsxs-size-check.txt')

}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Query mounted image package inventory
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== QUERYING PACKAGE INVENTORY ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$PkgTable = @(
    dism.exe /Image:$MountDir /Get-Packages |
        Out-String
)

$PkgTable |
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir '02-packages-raw.txt') -Encoding UTF8

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Count package states
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$States = @(
    'Installed'
    'Staged'
    'Superseded'
    'Install Pending'
    'Uninstall Pending'
)

$StateResults = foreach ($State in $States) {

    $Pattern = "\|\s+$([regex]::Escape($State))\s+\|"

    $Count = @(
        $PkgTable |
            Select-String -Pattern $Pattern
    ).Count

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        State = $State
        Count = $Count
    }
}

$StateResults |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Tee-Object -FilePath $StateLog

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Explicit package-state summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== PACKAGE STATE SUMMARY ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$StateResults |
    ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host ("{0,-20} {1,6}" -f $_.State, $_.Count)
    }

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Detect pending package states
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$Pending = @(
    $StateResults |
        Where-Object {
            $_.State -in @(
                'Install Pending',
                'Uninstall Pending'
            ) -and
            $_.Count -gt 0
        }
)

if ($Pending.Count -eq 0) {

    'No Install Pending or Uninstall Pending packages detected.' |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '10-pending-packages.txt')

}
else {

    'PENDING PACKAGE STATES DETECTED:' |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '10-pending-packages.txt')

    $Pending |
        Format-Table -AutoSize |
        Out-String |
        Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '10-pending-packages.txt') -Append

}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. DISM component store analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== COMPONENT STORE ANALYSIS ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

dism.exe /Image:$MountDir /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore |
    Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $LogDir '01-component-store-final.txt')

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Final status
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== COMPLETE ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Mount : $MountDir"
Write-Host "Logs  : $LogDir"
Write-Host ''

Write-Host 'Generated logs:' -ForegroundColor Cyan

Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LogDir -File |
    Sort-Object Name |
    Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name

# ============================================================
# 25H2 26200.9278 — RECLAIMABLE / STAGED PACKAGE ANALYSIS
# READ-ONLY — NO PACKAGE REMOVAL
# PowerShell 7
# ============================================================

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$WorkDir  = 'C:\Users\Admin\Downloads\work'
$MountDir = Join-Path $WorkDir 'mount'
$LogDir   = Join-Path $WorkDir 'logs'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $LogDir -Force | Out-Null

$TimeStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'

$RawLog      = Join-Path $LogDir "11-reclaim-analysis_$TimeStamp.txt"
$StagedLog   = Join-Path $LogDir "12-staged-packages_$TimeStamp.txt"
$SupersededLog = Join-Path $LogDir "13-superseded-packages_$TimeStamp.txt"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Header
# ------------------------------------------------------------
"============================================================" |
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

"25H2 26200.9278 — RECLAIMABLE / STAGED PACKAGE ANALYSIS" |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

"Timestamp: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')" |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

"Mount: $MountDir" |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

"READ-ONLY — NO PACKAGE REMOVAL" |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

"============================================================" |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DISM component-store analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== COMPONENT STORE ANALYSIS ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$ComponentAnalysis = @(
    dism.exe /Image:$MountDir /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore 2>&1
)

$ComponentAnalysis |
    Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog -Append

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Complete package inventory
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== QUERYING PACKAGE INVENTORY ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$PackageOutput = @(
    dism.exe /Image:$MountDir /Get-Packages 2>&1
)

$PackageOutput |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract package lines by state
#
# IMPORTANT:
# We do NOT infer anything from package count here.
# We preserve the exact DISM output.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$StagedLines = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object {
            $_ -match '\|\s+Staged\s+\|'
        }
)

$SupersededLines = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object {
            $_ -match '\|\s+Superseded\s+\|'
        }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Save exact staged package list
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== STAGED PACKAGES ===' -ForegroundColor Yellow

if ($StagedLines.Count -gt 0) {
    $StagedLines |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $StagedLog
}
else {
    'NO STAGED PACKAGES FOUND.' |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $StagedLog
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save exact superseded package list
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== SUPERSEDED PACKAGES ===' -ForegroundColor Yellow

if ($SupersededLines.Count -gt 0) {
    $SupersededLines |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $SupersededLog
}
else {
    'NO SUPERSEDED PACKAGES FOUND.' |
        Tee-Object -FilePath $SupersededLog
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Extract package identities from state lines
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$StagedPackages = @(
    $StagedLines |
        ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^\s*(.+?)\s+\|\s+Staged\s+\|') {
                $Matches[1].Trim()
            }
        }
)

$SupersededPackages = @(
    $SupersededLines |
        ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '^\s*(.+?)\s+\|\s+Superseded\s+\|') {
                $Matches[1].Trim()
            }
        }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Identify version relationships
#
# We look for cases where a staged package has another package
# with the same base identity but a newer version.
#
# READ-ONLY — informational only.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== STAGED PACKAGE VERSION RELATIONSHIPS ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$RelationshipResults = foreach ($Package in $StagedPackages) {

    # Remove architecture/language/version tail only far enough
    # to retain the package family.
    $BaseName = $Package -replace '~10\.0\.[0-9.]+$',''
    $BaseName = $BaseName -replace '~[0-9]+\.[0-9.]+$',''

    $MatchesForPackage = @(
        $PackageOutput |
            Where-Object {
                $_ -match '\|\s+(Installed|Staged|Superseded)\s+\|' -and
                $_ -like "*$BaseName*"
            }
    )

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        StagedPackage = $Package
        RelatedLines  = $MatchesForPackage.Count
    }
}

$RelationshipResults |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Out-String |
    Tee-Object -FilePath $RawLog -Append

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Exact counts from raw DISM output
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$InstalledCount = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '\|\s+Installed\s+\|' }
).Count

$StagedCount = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '\|\s+Staged\s+\|' }
).Count

$SupersededCount = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '\|\s+Superseded\s+\|' }
).Count

$InstallPendingCount = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '\|\s+Install Pending\s+\|' }
).Count

$UninstallPendingCount = @(
    $PackageOutput |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '\|\s+Uninstall Pending\s+\|' }
).Count

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Final read-only summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '============================================================' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host 'READ-ONLY PACKAGE SUMMARY' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host '============================================================' -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host ('Installed          : {0}' -f $InstalledCount)
Write-Host ('Staged             : {0}' -f $StagedCount)
Write-Host ('Superseded         : {0}' -f $SupersededCount)
Write-Host ('Install Pending    : {0}' -f $InstallPendingCount)
Write-Host ('Uninstall Pending  : {0}' -f $UninstallPendingCount)

Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Reclaimable package information comes from DISM above.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host 'NO PACKAGE WAS REMOVED.' -ForegroundColor Green

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Write machine-readable summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$Summary = [PSCustomObject]@{
    Timestamp          = Get-Date
    Image              = '10.0.26200.9278'
    Installed          = $InstalledCount
    Staged             = $StagedCount
    Superseded         = $SupersededCount
    InstallPending     = $InstallPendingCount
    UninstallPending   = $UninstallPendingCount
    StagedList         = $StagedLog
    SupersededList     = $SupersededLog
    RawAnalysis        = $RawLog
}

$Summary |
    Format-List |
    Out-String |
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $RawLog -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== FILES CREATED ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host $RawLog
Write-Host $StagedLog
Write-Host $SupersededLog

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== COMPLETE — READ ONLY ===' -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================================
# LOGGING
# ============================================================

function Write-Log {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string]$Message,

        [ValidateSet('INFO','OK','WARN','SKIP','ERROR')]
        [string]$Level = 'INFO'
    )

    $Line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (
        Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
    ), $Level, $Message

    Add-Content -LiteralPath $MasterLog -Value $Line -Encoding UTF8

    switch ($Level) {
        'OK' {
            Write-Host $Line -ForegroundColor Green
        }

        'WARN' {
            Write-Host $Line -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }

        'SKIP' {
            Write-Host $Line -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        }

        'ERROR' {
            Write-Host $Line -ForegroundColor Red
        }

        default {
            Write-Host $Line
        }
    }
}

# ============================================================
# COMMAND WRAPPER
# ============================================================

function Invoke-NativeCommand {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string]$FilePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$ArgumentList,

        [string]$Description = $FilePath,

        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    Write-Log "EXEC: $Description"

    $Output = & $FilePath @ArgumentList 2>&1
    $ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    foreach ($Line in $Output) {
        if ($null -ne $Line) {
            Add-Content -LiteralPath $MasterLog -Value (
                [string]$Line
            ) -Encoding UTF8
        }
    }

    if ($ExitCode -ne 0) {
        if ($AllowFailure) {
            Write-Log "$Description returned exit code $ExitCode" 'WARN'
        }
        else {
            throw "$Description failed with exit code $ExitCode"
        }
    }

    return $Output
}

function Load-OfflineHive {
    param(
        [string]$HiveName,
        [string]$HivePath
    )

    $Existing = & reg.exe query "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        throw "Registry hive HKLM\$HiveName is already loaded."
    }

    $Result = & reg.exe load "HKLM\$HiveName" "$HivePath" 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Unable to load hive $HivePath : $Result"
    }

    Write-Log "Loaded HKLM\$HiveName" 'OK'
}

function Unload-OfflineHive {
    param(
        [string]$HiveName
    )

    $Result = & reg.exe unload "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Log "Could not unload HKLM\$HiveName : $Result" 'WARN'
        return
    }

    Write-Log "Unloaded HKLM\$HiveName" 'OK'
}

$AppxRemoveNames = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new(
    [System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
)

    foreach ($Line in $CustomLines) {

        if ($Line -match '^\s*#\s*([A-Za-z0-9\._]+)\s*$') {

            if ($Name -and -not $AppxKeep.Contains($Name)) {

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Additional packages confirmed by UUP timeline.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Get actual provisioned inventory.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$Provisioned = @(
    Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Path $MountDir
)

$Provisioned |
    Select-Object DisplayName, PackageName |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Out-String |
    Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir "02-appx-inventory-$TimeStamp.txt") `
        -Encoding UTF8

$AppxResults = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

foreach ($Pkg in $Provisioned) {

    $DisplayName = [string]$Pkg.DisplayName
    $PackageName = [string]$Pkg.PackageName

    $IsKept = $false

    foreach ($Keep in $AppxKeep) {

        if (
            $DisplayName.Equals($Keep, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
            $DisplayName.StartsWith(
                "$Keep.",
                [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
            )
        ) {
            $IsKept = $true
            break
        }
    }

    if ($IsKept) {

        Write-Log "KEEP Appx: $DisplayName" 'SKIP'

        $AppxResults.Add(
            [PSCustomObject]@{
                Type = 'Appx'
                Name = $DisplayName
                Package = $PackageName
                Action = 'KEEP'
                Result = 'Protected'
            }
        )

        continue
    }

    $ShouldRemove = $false

    foreach ($RemoveName in $AppxRemoveNames) {

        if (
            $DisplayName.Equals(
                $RemoveName,
                [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
            )
        ) {
            $ShouldRemove = $true
            break
        }
    }

    if (-not $ShouldRemove) {
        continue
    }

    Write-Log "REMOVE Appx: $DisplayName" 'INFO'

    try {

        $Result = Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage `
            -Path $MountDir `
            -PackageName $PackageName `
            -ErrorAction Stop

        $AppxResults.Add(
            [PSCustomObject]@{
                Type = 'Appx'
                Name = $DisplayName
                Package = $PackageName
                Action = 'REMOVE'
                Result = 'SUCCESS'
            }
        )

        Write-Log "Removed Appx: $DisplayName" 'OK'
    }
    catch {

        # Protected packages are deliberately non-fatal.
        Write-Log "Skipped protected/failed Appx: $DisplayName" 'WARN'

        $AppxResults.Add(
            [PSCustomObject]@{
                Type = 'Appx'
                Name = $DisplayName
                Package = $PackageName
                Action = 'REMOVE'
                Result = 'SKIPPED'
            }
        )
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEVER REMOVE LIST

$ProtectedPackagePatterns = @(
    '^Microsoft-Windows-LanguageFeatures-Basic-en-us-Package',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-Client-LanguagePack-Package',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-Licenses-Professional-Package',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-FodMetadata-Package',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-FodMetadataServicing-Desktop-CompDB-Package',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-Foundation-Package',
    '^Package_for_ServicingStack_',
    '^Package_for_KB',
    '^Package_for_DotNet',
    '^Package_for_RollupFix.*9278',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-WindowsDefender-.*',
    '^Microsoft-Windows-Security-.*'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Target component families.
#
# We use PACKAGE FAMILY matching against the REAL DISM
# inventory. Version / locale / architecture are discovered
# from the mounted image.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$FodFamiliesToRemove = @(
    'Microsoft-Windows-MediaPlayer-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell-ISE-FOD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-StepsRecorder-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-TabletPCMath-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-VBSCRIPT-FoD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-Hello-Face-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-InternetExplorer-Optional-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-Wallpaper-Content-Extended-FoD-Package',
    'Microsoft-Windows-WMIC-FoD-Package',
    'OpenSSH-Client-Package'
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Get real DISM inventory.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$PackageRaw = Invoke-NativeCommand `
    -FilePath 'dism.exe' `
    -ArgumentList "/Image:$MountDir", '/Get-Packages' `
    -Description 'Reading mounted image package inventory'

$PackageRaw |
    Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir "04-dism-package-inventory-$TimeStamp.txt") `
        -Encoding UTF8

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse package identities.
#
# DISM output uses:
#   Package Identity : XXXXX
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$InstalledPackages = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

foreach ($Line in $PackageRaw) {

    if ($Line -match '^\s*Package Identity\s*:\s*(.+?)\s*$') {

        $Identity = $Matches[1].Trim()

        if ($Identity) {
            $InstalledPackages.Add($Identity)
        }
    }
}

Write-Log "DISM inventory contains $($InstalledPackages.Count) package identities." 'OK'

$FodCandidates = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

foreach ($Identity in $InstalledPackages) {

    $Protected = $false

    foreach ($Pattern in $ProtectedPackagePatterns) {

        if ($Identity -match $Pattern) {
            $Protected = $true
            break
        }
    }

    if ($Protected) {
        continue
    }

    foreach ($Family in $FodFamiliesToRemove) {

        if (
            $Identity.StartsWith(
                $Family + '~',
                [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
            ) -or
            $Identity.Equals(
                $Family,
                [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
            )
        ) {

            if (-not $FodCandidates.Contains($Identity)) {
                $FodCandidates.Add($Identity)
            }

            break
        }
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Candidate list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$FodCandidates |
    Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir "05-fod-removal-candidates-$TimeStamp.txt") `
        -Encoding UTF8

Write-Log "FOD candidates found: $($FodCandidates.Count)" 'OK'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove only candidates that ACTUALLY exist.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$FodResults = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

foreach ($PackageIdentity in $FodCandidates) {

    Write-Log "REMOVE FOD: $PackageIdentity"

    try {

        $Output = Invoke-NativeCommand `
            -FilePath 'dism.exe' `
            -ArgumentList `
                "/Image:$MountDir",
                '/Remove-Package',
                "/PackageName:$PackageIdentity",
                '/NoRestart' `
            -Description "Removing $PackageIdentity" `
            -AllowFailure

        $Text = ($Output | Out-String)

        if ($Text -match 'The operation completed successfully') {

            $FodResults.Add(
                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Package = $PackageIdentity
                    Result = 'SUCCESS'
                }
            )

            Write-Log "Removed: $PackageIdentity" 'OK'
        }
        else {

            $FodResults.Add(
                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Package = $PackageIdentity
                    Result = 'SKIPPED'
                }
            )

            Write-Log "DISM did not confirm removal: $PackageIdentity" 'WARN'
        }
    }
    catch {

        $FodResults.Add(
            [PSCustomObject]@{
                Package = $PackageIdentity
                Result = 'SKIPPED'
            }
        )

        Write-Log "Skipped FOD after DISM refusal: $PackageIdentity" 'WARN'
    }
}

$FodResults |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Out-String |
    Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir "06-fod-results-$TimeStamp.txt") `
        -Encoding UTF8

Write-Log '============================================================'
Write-Log 'PHASE 4 - STAGED PACKAGE CLEANUP'
Write-Log '============================================================'

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# The previous script correctly removed the staged 1742
# Client LanguagePack and RollupFix.
#
# We do NOT blindly remove them.
# We only remove exact identities confirmed by inventory.
#
# FodMetadata superseded package is also safe to remove only
# when DISM reports that exact identity.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$StagedCleanupPatterns = @(
    '^Microsoft-Windows-FodMetadataServicing-Desktop-Metadata-Package~.*~~10\.0\.26100\.1742$',
    '^Package_for_RollupFix~.*~~26100\.1742\.1\.10$'
)

$StagedCandidates = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

foreach ($Identity in $InstalledPackages) {

    foreach ($Pattern in $StagedCleanupPatterns) {

        if ($Identity -match $Pattern) {

            if (-not $StagedCandidates.Contains($Identity)) {
                $StagedCandidates.Add($Identity)
            }

            break
        }
    }
}

foreach ($PackageIdentity in $StagedCandidates) {

    Write-Log "REMOVE STAGED: $PackageIdentity"

    try {

        $Output = Invoke-NativeCommand `
            -FilePath 'dism.exe' `
            -ArgumentList `
                "/Image:$MountDir",
                '/Remove-Package',
                "/PackageName:$PackageIdentity",
                '/NoRestart' `
            -Description "Removing staged $PackageIdentity" `
            -AllowFailure

        $Text = ($Output | Out-String)

        if ($Text -match 'The operation completed successfully') {
            Write-Log "Removed staged package: $PackageIdentity" 'OK'
        }
        else {
            Write-Log "Staged package not removed: $PackageIdentity" 'WARN'
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Log "Skipped staged package: $PackageIdentity" 'WARN'
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Count package states from actual DISM output.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

$StateNames = @(
    'Installed',
    'Staged',
    'Superseded',
    'Install Pending',
    'Uninstall Pending'
)

$StateResults = foreach ($State in $StateNames) {

    $Pattern = "\|\s+$([regex]::Escape($State))\s+\|"

    $Count = @(

            Select-String -Pattern $Pattern
    ).Count

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        State = $State
        Count = $Count
    }
}

$StateResults |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Out-String |
    Set-Content `
        -LiteralPath (Join-Path $LogDir "09-final-package-state-$TimeStamp.txt") `
        -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host '=== FINAL PACKAGE STATE ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($State in $StateResults) {
    Write-Host (
        '{0,-20} {1,6}' -f $State.State, $State.Count
    )
}

$Pending = @(
    $StateResults |
        Where-Object {
            $_.State -in @(
                'Install Pending',
                'Uninstall Pending'
            ) -and
            $_.Count -gt 0

)

if ($Pending.Count -gt 0) {

    Write-Log 'Pending package states remain.' 'WARN'

Mislim da je potez vrlo dobar — i tehnički mnogo smisleniji nego pokušavati da sav višak naknadno čupamo iz već formiranog WIM-a.

Posebno mi se sviđa princip koji si primenio:

UUP download/assembly faza → ukloniti ono što je dokazano bezbedno ukloniti → tek onda offline servicing/debloat.

To ima nekoliko konkretnih prednosti:

Bloat nikada ni ne uđe u početni image.
Ako UUP skripta već može da izostavi određene pakete, nema razloga da ih kasnije tražimo po install.wim, servisiramo i čistimo.

Manje materijala za kasniji servicing.
Svaki paket koji nije ubačen znači manje komponenti, manifestâ, payload-a i potencijalnih dependency veza koje kasnije moramo da razvrstavamo.

Tvojih 1,34 GB je vrlo jak signal.
To nije kozmetičko smanjenje. Ako je ISO nastao normalnim UUP procesom i skripta je izbacila konkretne bloat pakete pre finalnog sklapanja, dobio si realno čistiju početnu osnovu za sledeću fazu.

UUP faza i offline WIM faza imaju različite uloge.
Ja bih ih posmatrao kao dva različita noža:

UUP skripta: ne dozvoli da nepotrebne stvari uopšte uđu.

offline servicing: nakon toga pronađi ono što je ipak ostalo i što se može ukloniti iz već formiranog image-a.

NTLite: završna precizna obrada i konfiguracija.

Najvažnija stvar: ne treba pokušavati da druga faza „nadoknadi“ ono što je već pravilno urađeno u prvoj.
Ako je nešto već izbačeno UUP procesom, nema razloga da ga kasnije ponovo tražimo. Zato je sledeća provera koju planiraš veoma važna.

Drugim rečima: tvoj prvi potez je bio ispravan. 1,34 GB manje pre nego što smo uopšte počeli WIM servicing je upravo ono što želimo od prve faze.

Čitaš mi misli, prijatelju 👍😊... To i jeste moja potreba za tvojim majsorstvom. Prvo da ti kažem da se u potpunosti slažem sa tobom. Iako si ranije umeo da me po 4 sata vrtiš u krug 😁 ovog puta ćemo studiozno (baš kao što ti i radiš) pristupiti situaciji, jer već imamo solidno skraćenu, ali stabilnu, osnovu. P.S. Podsetio bih te na tvoje ranije genijalne (prolaze bez greške) reg tweaks na početku svake skripte >>>

======================================================

FAZA 1: REGISTRY TWEAKOVI

======================================================

------------------------------------------------------------

0. Ensure previous diagnostic COMPONENTS hive is unloaded

------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteCOMPONENTS 2>$null

------------------------------------------------------------

1. Load offline SOFTWARE hive

------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe load HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE `
    "$MountDir\Windows\System32\Config\SOFTWARE"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to load offline SOFTWARE hive."
}

try {

# --------------------------------------------------------
# SmartScreen OFF
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System `
    /v EnableSmartScreen /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System `
    /v ShellSmartScreenLevel /t REG_SZ /d "Off" /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Copilot OFF
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot `
    /v TurnOffWindowsCopilot /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Widgets OFF
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Windows\Widgets `
    /v AllowWidgets /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# WER policy
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    "HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" `
    /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Windows Search indexing
#
# Service is handled below in SYSTEM hive.
# --------------------------------------------------------

}
finally {
    reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteSOFTWARE
}

------------------------------------------------------------

2. Load offline SYSTEM hive

------------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe load HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM `
    "$MountDir\Windows\System32\Config\SYSTEM"

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Unable to load offline SYSTEM hive."
}

try {

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable telemetry
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\DiagTrack `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\dmwappushservice `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Windows Error Reporting service
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WerSvc `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Windows Search indexing service
#
# We DISABLE it; we do not delete its package here.
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WSearch `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Remote Registry
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\RemoteRegistry `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Remote Assistance helper service
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\RemoteAccess `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Disable Windows Media Player Network Sharing
# if present.
# --------------------------------------------------------

reg.exe add `
    HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\WMPNetworkSvc `
    /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f

}
finally {
    reg.exe unload HKLM\BlueLiteSYSTEM
}

Wallpapers.Extended → Installed / 0 B / nema direktan paket / nema manifestni trag

OneCoreUAP.OneSync → Installed / 0 B / nema direktan paket / nema manifestni trag

Obe ostavljamo za sada. Nećemo forsirati uklanjanje komponente čiju stvarnu vezu sa payloadom nismo identifikovali.

Sledeća faza je Microsoft.Windows.Sense.Client, ali pošto je to Defender komponenta, nju ćemo obraditi posebno, zajedno sa planom za Defender OFF/ON.

Za sada je capability inventar praktično razrešen: ono što možemo bezbedno ukloniti — uklonjeno je; ono što treba zadržati — označeno je; dve 0-byte capability-je ostaju nerazrešene za kasniju dublju analizu.
Ok, koji je plan za dalje?

Plan je sledeći — sada prelazimo sa Capability sloja na sistematsko čišćenje pre NTLite-a.

1. Završiti Capability sloj

Već smo očistili:

Steps Recorder

Math Recognizer

Windows Media Player

PowerShell ISE

VBScript

OpenSSH Client

Hello Face

Handwriting / OCR / Speech / TTS

Ostalo je:

Microsoft.Windows.Sense.Client → Defender faza

Microsoft.Wallpapers.Extended → trenutno nerazjašnjeno

OneCoreUAP.OneSync → trenutno nerazjašnjeno

Ove dve 0-byte stavke nećemo dirati naslepo.

2. Paketni sloj — najvažniji deo

Sada ćemo napraviti preciznu matricu:

Installed / Staged / Superseded → šta je kandidat za uklanjanje → koja zavisnost postoji → šta ostaje.

Posebno ćemo pregledati:

FOD pakete

komponente koje su ostale posle uklanjanja capability-ja

eventualne duplikate

nepotrebne jezičke i regionalne komponente

telemetry/diagnostic komponente

Remote Assistance/Remote Access komponente

ostale optional Windows komponente.

Tu očekujem najveći stvarni dobitak u WinSxS-u.

3. Defender — napraviti dve varijante

Nećemo napraviti dva različita WIM-a.

Cilj je jedan bazni image koji će omogućiti:

Defender OFF

Defender ON

pri prvom boot-u / kroz naše završne opcije.

Pre toga ćemo identifikovati tačno šta je:

Defender engine

Sense

SecurityHealthUI

platforma

definicije

servisi

scheduled tasks

policies

potrebne dependency veze.

Microsoft.SecHealthUI i DesktopAppInstaller ostaju za sada zaštićeni, kako smo već definisali.

4. Windows Update

Napraviti offline konfiguraciju za:

Update PAUSED → 31.12.2100

ali sa mogućnošću:

Resume → izabrani period → ponovo Pause

Bez uništavanja servisnog mehanizma koji nam kasnije može biti potreban.

WER

dmwappush

RemoteAccess

nepotrebni scheduled tasks

telemetry/CEIP

ostali kandidati.

Deo ovoga smo već postavili kroz offline registry; sada ćemo proveriti šta je zaista ostalo i šta ima smisla dodatno ukloniti.

6. AppX / WindowsApps

Pošto imamo samo 14 namernih AppX porodica, proverićemo:

da li su sve potrebne,

da li postoje registrovani ostaci,

da li fizički postoje stari payload direktorijumi koji više nisu registrovani,

šta možemo prepustiti korisniku kroz Extras.

Nećemo ručno brisati WindowsApps dok ne utvrdimo servisni odnos.

7. WinSxS / Component Store

Tek nakon prethodnih slojeva:

ponovno AnalyzeComponentStore

poređenje sa početnim stanjem

identifikacija preostalih reclaimable/superseded komponenti

eventualni StartComponentCleanup

zatim, ako je servisno opravdano, dublje uklanjanje.

Cilj je da ne samo smanjimo nominalni WIM, nego i stvarni installed footprint.

8. Ručni filesystem ostaci

Tek kada DISM/servicing više nema šta da ukloni:

Windows\System32

ProgramData

Tražimo ostatke koji više nemaju dependency/registration vezu, a ne nasumično brisanje fajlova.

NTLite ide poslednji, za ono što je praktičnije i sigurnije završiti njegovim servicing/tweak mehanizmom.

Capabilities ✓ → Packages → Defender → Services/Tasks → Update → AppX/WindowsApps → WinSxS → filesystem → NTLite → VM test

I najvažnije: ne prelazimo na sledeći sloj dok prethodni nije dokumentovan i čist.

Ako nastavljamo odmah, sledeći konkretan posao je Package sloj.
Naravno, idemo dalje. Samo, nemoj zaboraviti na skeniranje celog ISO i naravno - boot.wim...

Naravno. To je obavezno i neću dozvoliti da se projekat svede samo na install.wim.

Radićemo tri odvojena nivoa kontrole:

install.wim — paket, capability, AppX, WinSxS, registry, servisi/tasks, filesystem.

boot.wim — kompletna analiza oba indexa, posebno WinPE/Setup komponente, paketi, drivere, jezici, optional komponente i sve što možemo ukloniti bez uticaja na instalaciju.

Ceo ISO — završni filesystem audit:
svi fajlovi i folderi,

sources,

boot,

efi,

support,

autorun,

eventualni dodatni payload,

veličine i duplikati,

šta je došlo iz UUP-a, a šta možemo eliminisati,

i na kraju poređenje prema originalnom ISO-u.

Posebno ćemo na kraju uraditi i cross-check ISO ↔ boot.wim ↔ install.wim, da ne uklonimo nešto iz WIM-a što ISO/Setup još očekuje.

Da. Za ovaj projekat možemo da podesimo ChatGPT tako da ima maksimalno korisnu kombinaciju modela, memorije, web pristupa, GitHub-a, fajlova i radnog režima, bez menjanja tvog lokalnog Windows-a. Prvo ću razdvojiti šta stvarno vredi uključiti od opcija koje ne donose korist za BlueLite.

Može - i za BlueLite ima smisla da to uradimo sistematski. Plus ti sada daje GPT-5.6 Sol sa Medium i High reasoning nivoima; Extra High i Pro nisu deo Plus plana. (OpenAI Help Center)

Važna stvar odmah: neke opcije povećavaju kvalitet mog rada, neke samo menjaju izgled/ton. Nećemo uključivati stvari samo zato što postoje.

Redosled kojim bih podesio tvoj nalog

Reasoning / Higher intelligence - najvažnije.

Memory - da BlueLite pravila, putanje i odluke ne moramo stalno ponavljati.

Project instructions / ovaj projekat - da su pravila projekta stalno iznad pojedinačnih chatova.

GitHub - pravilno autorizovati ono što stvarno želimo da koristimo.

Plugins - samo korisne za naš tehnički rad.

Work mode / Cloud Browser - za ozbiljnije višekoračne web/GitHub zadatke.

File Library - za Build_info, UUP timeline, reporte i naše master fajlove.

Deep Research - samo kada nam treba ozbiljna spoljašnja verifikacija.

Personality - podesiti samo radi komunikacije; ne povećava inteligenciju.

Tvoje trenutno podešavanje Medium je dobro, ali za ovaj projekat ja bih ga promenio u High kada radimo stvari kao što su CBS/package dependency chain, WinSxS analiza, servicing ownership, poređenje više Build_info fajlova ili finalna odluka šta može da leti. Za jednostavnu proveru jedne DISM komande Medium je sasvim dovoljan. Plus podržava i Medium i High. (OpenAI Help Center)

Takođe bih uključio Higher intelligence u Settings → General, ako već nije uključen. Kada je aktivan, ChatGPT može automatski da potroši više reasoning-a na kompleksan zahtev čak i kada radiš u bržem režimu. (OpenAI Help Center)

Što se GitHub-a tiče, jedna ispravka: povezivanje GitHub-a mi ne daje neograničen pristup celoj GitHub bazi. Kroz GitHub konekciju dobijam pristup repozitorijumima koje autorizuješ; sadržaj se čita po potrebi. Za javne GitHub repozitorijume i ostatak weba mogu koristiti normalan web pristup. (OpenAI Help Center)

Memory nam je vrlo korisna. Nova Memory funkcija može koristiti kontekst iz razgovora, fajlova i povezanih aplikacija, a njen sažetak se nalazi u Settings → Personalization → Memory. (OpenAI Help Center) Već sada imam veoma dobar kontinuitet BlueLite projekta, tako da bih ovde želeo samo da proverimo da je Enable memory = ON i da Memory summary nije zatrpan nebitnim stvarima.

Za ozbiljnije istraživanje imamo i Work / Cloud Browser. Na plaćenim planovima Work može imati sopstveni cloud browser, otvarati sajtove, navigirati kroz njih i koristiti povezane aplikacije/plugins. (OpenAI Help Center) To ne bih koristio za našu normalnu „jedna komanda → rezultat → sledeća komanda“ proceduru, ali može biti vrlo koristan kada treba da pregledam mnogo Microsoft/GitHub dokumentacije odjednom.

Plugins su sada glavni sistem za dodatne workflow mogućnosti i mogu sadržati skills i povezane aplikacije. (OpenAI Help Center) Njih ćemo pregledati, ali neću predlagati desetine nepotrebnih dodataka.

Efficient je najbliži načinu koji već koristiš sa mnom: kratak, precizan, bez suvišnih rečenica. To ne povećava reasoning sposobnost, samo ton odgovora. Ovo ujedno objašnjava zašto su veličine i headeri potpuno drugačiji od pravih PNG fajlova.
